runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 8.9.2026 21:52 CEST. No new unique promotion-grade item passed ranking and evidence gates. Supplemental public-index discovery found FEIM-SK e-shop sales specialist in Malacky, 1,100-1,300 EUR/month, but intermediate English and active retail sales materially reduce fit. Upwork produced fresh Worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce jobs, but the best new items were either hard-development scope or low fixed budgets (10-100 USD). Reddit yielded no eligible fresh hiring lead and Facebook public index yielded 0 verified hiring posts. Existing 50 LIVE items are preserved fail-closed.
